title: contrast report
description: The contrast report for one tokens.json. Written by scripts/contrast.mjs --out, or by hand with the formula in references/tokens.md. A build fails when failed is above 0.

tokens.description: Path of the tokens.json checked, as given.

themes.description: Theme ids, in the tokens file's order.

failed.description: Rows in pairs whose pass is false.

over.description: The opaque surface bg was composited onto.

ratio.description: WCAG contrast ratio, truncated to two decimals so it never rounds up past a floor.

reference_ratio.description: The same pair with every departed token at its reference value. Present only when fg, bg or over has a departure.

pairs.description: One row per declared pair per theme, in declaration order, themes inner.

departures.description: One row per departed token per theme, in token order.
